## Project Summary

**What it is:** A Python web app for Maple Row Physiotherapy clinic that lets patients submit appointment requests and intake forms, which staff review at `/admin`. Built with standard library only (no external packages) to run on the clinic's locked-down front-desk PC.

**Rules that must be followed:**
- **No external dependencies** — Python stdlib only, runs offline, no internet required
- **Requests only, never bookings** — patient-facing pages say "Request received — we'll call you within one business day" (staff confirm by phone)
- **Strict PHIPA compliance** — intake answers are personal health info under Ontario privacy law; nothing leaves the server (no email, third-party services, external scripts, fonts, CDNs, analytics)
- **Staff access only** — requests viewable in `/admin` only; no exports, downloads, or spreadsheet shortcuts
- **No payment collection** — no payment UI until payment addendum is signed; PREVIEW banner stays on all pages
- **No deployment** — don't push anywhere or add remotes
- **Generic notifications** — staff/patient notifications can only say "new request" or "request received"

**Still owed before go-live:**
- **Dr. Anita Rao** (clinic's privacy officer) must sign off on the consent wording on the intake form
- Go-live is postponed — was Oct 5; now deferred until end of month when Dr. Rao returns
